reproduce.module: Always On Top FrameDrawer and WindowBorder
reproduce.expected_result: A configured1px border remains visibly consistent on all intended edges at rest and after motion without covering application content or creating a gap.
steps: At1px and2px record extended-frame bounds, border HWND rectangle, draw geometry and exposed ring on every edge.
Compare stationary rendering with move/resize and settle, including top edge and rounded corners.
Move between mixed-DPI displays and compare rectangular/rounded and maximized/restored windows.
Check that any correction preserves no-gap/no-overlap behavior and does not change target topmost state.
reproduce.version_requirement: Current stable and current development build
prerequisites: Use disposable normal and legacy/custom-frame windows at100%,125%,150% and200% DPI; include Skype for Business where available.

judgment.recommended_action: Validate1px/2px bounds and exposed-ring geometry across window types and DPI, then correct the demonstrated inset/scaling mismatch.
judgment.rationale: There is enough evidence for a maintainer-owned geometry test and narrow correction. Measure the exposed physical-pixel ring at rest and during motion; preserve the reason for the existing inset and prevent border overlap regressions.
evidence: Read the original0.63.0 report, all three replies and timeline; inspected the original two and later five screenshots.
The reporter confirmed recurrence on0.85.1 across PCs, partially missing top edges on other windows and no stable 1px border on Skype for Business.
Both the report and supplied images distinguish 1px from the2px workaround and describe all sides becoming visible during movement before settling behind the target.
Current GetFrameRect expands DWM extended-frame bounds by configured thickness; UpdateBorderProperties separately DPI-scales the rendered thickness.
Both FrameDrawer::ConvertRect overloads add a fixed1px inset, and border positioning intentionally places the border behind the target; geometry and occlusion need to be measured together.

proposed_fixes.title: Preserve the visible1px ring outside tracked window bounds
plan: Measure target/border/draw bounds at rest and while moving to identify the first clipping or scaling mismatch.
Correct the demonstrated physical-pixel relationship in both rectangular and rounded draw paths, retaining the original gap-prevention intent.
Add1px/2px, mixed-DPI and legacy/custom-frame geometry regressions without globally moving the border above application content.
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: the fixed inward pixel adjustment and behind-target placement consume the exposed1px ring; compare configured frame expansion with DPI-scaled rendering before changing either.

confidence.rationale: All supplied images and the exact fixed-inset/scaling/z-order source support a narrow geometry lead; current runtime attribution and acceptance remain unexecuted.

verification: Assert exposed-ring dimensions and inspect stationary/moving visual results.
Retain rounded/maximized, border toggle, focus and pin-state controls.

fix_assessment.rationale: The visual1px/2px discriminator and exact fixed-inset/behind-target code are concrete, but no current geometry trace or regression-safe correction has been executed.
